name: SpendGate
description: Keyless spending turnstile for financial AI agents on Base (USDC). Owners draft MandatePolicy with their own SERV key; SpendGate stores policy and gates every spend — ALLOW / DENY / ESCALATE. AgentKit signs only after ALLOW. Non-custodial; does not store end-user Reasoning keys.

openserv.invoke: x402 payWorkflow with { prompt } — send MandatePolicy JSON; never SERV_API_KEY

ownerSide.requires: Owner SERV_API_KEY (one OpenServ Reasoning console step; no SIWE yet)

skills.description: Persist an accepted MandatePolicy JSON under a policyId. Keyless.
Deterministic allow | deny | escalate for a proposed spend. No transaction.
Evaluate then AgentKit USDC transfer only on ALLOW (or escalate + humanApproved).
OPERATOR ONLY when host SERV_API_KEY is set — not the end-user path.

invariants: Allow/deny/escalate is deterministic code — never LLM judgment
SpendGate does not custody user funds or private keys
End-user SERV_API_KEY stays on the owner agent — host never stores it
Host SERV_API_KEY is optional and only for operator self/dev Copilot
